description: This file contains Bash shell functions and scripts used for build automation, file checks, log analysis, git workflows, and related scripting tasks within a software project.

methods.name: require_artifact
methods.description: Checks if the specified artifact file exists and is non-empty; exits if not.

methods.name: path_is_docsish
methods.description: Determines if a path points to documentation or related markdown files.

methods.name: path_is_testish
methods.description: Determines if a path appears to be a test or test-related file.

methods.name: path_is_maintainer_workflow_only
methods.description: Checks if a path is a maintainer-specific workflow file or directory.

methods.name: file_list_is_docsish_only
methods.description: Checks if all files in a list are documentation-like files.

methods.name: changelog_required_for_changed_files
methods.description: Determines if a changelog is required based on file changes, excluding documentation, tests, or maintainer-only files.

methods.name: print_review_stdout_summary
methods.description: Prints a summary of code review, including recommendation and findings.

methods.name: print_relevant_log_excerpt
methods.description: Outputs relevant log lines filtered for errors or shows the last lines if no specific errors are found.

methods.name: print_unrelated_gate_failure_guidance
methods.description: Provides guidance when a build/test gate fails with known unrelated errors.

methods.name: run_quiet_logged
methods.description: Runs a command, logs output to a file, and reports success or failure with log excerpts.

methods.name: bootstrap_deps_if_needed
methods.description: Installs dependencies if not already installed.

methods.name: wait_for_pr_head_sha
methods.description: Waits until the pull request's head SHA matches the expected SHA.

methods.name: is_author_email_merge_error
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates a merge error related to author email issues.

methods.name: merge_author_email_candidates
methods.description: Suggests candidate emails for merge commits based on GitHub, local git config, and placeholders.

methods.name: common_repo_root
methods.description: Finds the top-level directory of the current repository.

methods.name: worktree_path_for_branch
methods.description: Finds the file system path of the worktree for a given branch.

methods.name: worktree_is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a given directory path is registered as a worktree.

methods.name: resolve_existing_dir_path
methods.description: Resolves and outputs the absolute path of an existing directory.

methods.name: is_repo_pr_worktree_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a PR checkout worktree within the repo.

methods.name: remove_worktree_if_present
methods.description: Removes a worktree directory if registered, or trashes it if possible, with warnings if not.

methods.name: delete_local_branch_if_safe
methods.description: Deletes a local branch if it is safe to do so (not checked out in a worktree).
